_comment: Irish fuel tax change events. Add rows as new budget measures are announced. Positive delta_eur_per_l = price increase, negative = cut. 'category' is one of: excise, carbon_tax, vat, nora_levy. 'delta_eur_per_l' is the change in that component per litre (VAT-inclusive if applicable). Source column keeps a link/note for auditability. Only the fuel columns you affect need a non-zero delta.
